read.thesis: PPG reaffirmed $7.70–$8.10 2026 EPS and says price-cost lag is now months, with up to 20% price increases against mid-single-digit COGS inflation; Q2 EPS guided flat to low single-digit growth.

triggers.label: Price increases up to 20% announced
triggers.quote: we announced -- I announced to the world price increases up to 20%

triggers.label: Four European plant closures, $25M fixed-cost cut
triggers.quote: we have 4 manufacturing plants that will be closed in the second half of 2026, resulting in lower fixed costs going forward

triggers.label: Price-cost lag now months, not years
Refinish volume recovering earlier than expected
triggers.quote: it's recovering a little earlier than we expected

guidance.quote: we are reaffirming our full year 2026 EPS guidance range of $7.70 to $8.10

guidance.value: flat to positive low single digits
guidance.quote: This will result in organic sales growth for the second quarter in the range of flat to positive low single digits

guidance.value: flat to positive low single digit %
